summary: Iteration 35 regression backend testing after 2 deployment fixes (supabase.js env-only, CORS_ORIGINS=* added). Returns 404 — no root route registered. /api/health (200) is the correct health endpoint. Not a regression.

GOOD: /app/backend/.env has CORS_ORIGINS=* on a single line, no comment noise, verified applied — Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * is served on all responses including preflight (OPTIONS returns 204).

GOOD: /api/plume-chat still functions end-to-end with astrology-api.io v3 chat/completions. Real API returned a 2213-char response for the exact review payload (Paris 1993-06-15 14:30) with animation + ## heading + ** bold + --- separator + open question.
MINOR (carry-over from iter34): server.py:1131 redundantly re-sets result['session_id'] after service call — harmless but dead code.
MINOR (carry-over from iter34): No rate limiting on public /api/plume-chat — a bot could burn ASTROLOGY_API_IO_KEY quota. Consider IP throttling.

MINOR: /api/rencontres/reveal accepts flat body (name/day/month/...) rather than {birth_data:{...}}. Slightly inconsistent with /api/plume-chat which nests birth_data. Not a bug but worth aligning schemas across endpoints.
